name: What's New on the Net

sources.title: Homepage — 'whatsnew.' tech news site, relaunched ('We are back'); daily AI/software/start-ups coverage dated through Sept 26, 2026
Contact — routed inboxes on newsdefused.com: tips@, editorial@, publisher@; PR/pitch expectations stated

requirements: This is an editorial tech publication, not a directory — the only free route is a news tip/PR pitch to tips@newsdefused.com
Coverage focuses on AI, software, hardware, semiconductors, emerging tech — with a Start-ups topic
Effective pitches per their own guidance: genuinely newsworthy developments, embargo/exclusive where relevant, access to engineers/researchers not just spokespeople, supporting docs/data/benchmarks
No guarantee of coverage; editorial independence is explicit ('We don't accept off-the-record commercial pitches dressed up as feedback')
preparation: A genuinely newsworthy angle — a plain 'we launched a SaaS' pitch is weak; funding, technical novelty, or data is stronger
Contact info for verification; state confidentiality needs upfront if any
workflow: Email tips@newsdefused.com with the pitch (or editorial@newsdefused.com for coverage suggestions)
Expect review of every tip but a reply only for promising ones, usually within 3–5 business days
If covered, the story appears in the relevant topic feed (e.g., Start-ups, Web Tools) with a dated article permalink
watchFor: Contact emails live on a different domain — newsdefused.com — not whatsnewonthenet.com
This is a small operation (publisher Jamie Ashcroft, Creamery Media Ltd); 'We can't guarantee coverage of pitches or tips'
No submission form, no listing page, no paid-placement mention — advertising is handled by publisher@newsdefused.com and kept separate from editorial
Batch's /conti URL is dead — nothing else on the domain accepts submissions
countsAsLive: A dated article about the product/company appears on whatsnewonthenet.com under a topic feed (e.g., Start-ups) with its own permalink
unknowns: Actual pickup rate for cold PR pitches
Whether articles link out with followed links
